description: This is a Java JUnit test class for testing database upgrade procedures from OpenMRS version 1.9.7 to 1.10. It contains setup and teardown methods, multiple test cases for validating various aspects of database migration, including data integrity, schema changes, privilege updates, and error handling.

classes.name: Database1_9_7UpgradeIT
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying database upgrade functionality from OpenMRS 1.9.7 to 1.10, extending the base context-sensitive test class, containing multiple test cases.

methods.name: beforeClass
methods.description: Sets up the temporary application data directory before all tests.

methods.name: afterClass
methods.description: Cleans up the temporary application data directory after all tests.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Initializes test utility before each test.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Closes database connections after each test.

methods.name: shouldUpgradeFromClean1_9To1_10
methods.description: Verifies upgrade process from a clean 1.9 database results in expected empty tables.

methods.name: shouldFailMigratingDrugOrdersIfUnitsToConceptsMappingsIsNotSet
methods.description: Ensures upgrade fails if units to concept mappings are not provided.

methods.name: shouldFailMigratingDrugOrdersIfUnitsToConceptsMappingsDoesNotPointToValidCodedDoseUnits
methods.description: Verifies upgrade failure when dose units mappings are invalid.

methods.name: shouldMigrateDrugOrders
methods.description: Checks the proper migration of drug orders and related concepts.

methods.name: shouldFailIfAnyDrugOrderUnitsNotMappedToConceptsAreFound
methods.description: Validates that upgrade fails when unmapped units are present.

methods.name: shouldFailIfAnyDrugOrderFrequenciesNotMappedToConceptsAreFound
methods.description: Validates that upgrade fails when unmapped frequencies are present.

methods.name: shouldPassIfAllExistingDrugOrderUnitsAndFrequenciesAreMappedToConcepts
methods.description: Ensures upgrade passes if all units and frequencies are properly mapped.

methods.name: shouldConvertOrderersToBeingProvidersInsteadOfUsers
methods.description: Verifies conversion of orderers from users to provider entities during upgrade.

methods.name: shouldConcatenateDoseStrengthAndUnits
methods.description: Checks correct concatenation of dose strength and units after migration.

methods.name: shouldFailIfThereAreDrugsWithDoseStrengthAndNoNullUnits
methods.description: Ensures failure if drugs have dose strength with non-null units but no data.

methods.name: shouldFailIfThereAreDrugsWithDoseStrengthAndNoBlankUnits
methods.description: Verifies failure if drugs have dose strength with units set to blank.

methods.name: shouldFailIfThereAreAnyOrderTypesInTheDatabaseOtherThanDrugOrderTypeAndNoNewColumns
methods.description: Tests upgrade failure when unexpected order types are found without new schema changes.

methods.name: shouldPassIfThereAreAnyOrderTypesInTheDatabaseOtherThanDrugOrderTypeAndTheNewColumnsExist
methods.description: Tests successful upgrade when extra order types exist but schema is upgraded accordingly.

methods.name: shouldCreateDiscontinuationOrderForStoppedOrders
methods.description: Validates creation of discontinuation orders for stopped orders during upgrade.

methods.name: shouldFailIfThereAreOrderersWithNoAssociatedProviderAccounts
methods.description: Ensures upgrade fails when references to non-existing provider accounts are encountered.

methods.name: shouldSetValuesToNullIfUnitsOrFrequencyBlank
methods.description: Checks that blank units or frequencies are set to null after upgrade.

methods.name: shouldAddTheNecessaryPrivilegesAndAssignThemToSpecificRoles
methods.description: Verifies that upgrade adds privileges and assigns them to roles as required.

methods.name: roleHasPrivilege
methods.description: Helper method to check if a specific role has a certain privilege.

methods.name: shouldUpgradeLiquibase
methods.description: Runs liquibase upgrade to ensure the master script executes without exception.
